snippet.title: Escape The Backrooms - 1.0 Launch Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description: The backrooms are expanding. Escape the Backrooms 1.0 is here, available now on PC, with console releases coming to Xbox and PlayStation in 2026. Explore over 30 unsettling levels, uncover secrets, and experience alternate endings that increase replayability. Each playthrough challenges your wits, timing, and nerve as you navigate ever-changing environments. Are you ready to escape?
